title: The congruent number 5
mathematical_role: Render the exact elliptic curve E₅, a verified rational point, and the corresponding exact rational right triangle while preserving the finite-search boundary.
learning_objective: Connect the exact equation y²=x³−25x and P=(25/4,75/8) to an area-five rational right triangle without mistaking a plotted sample for a complete description of E₅(Q).
literal_semantics: The plotted curve is deterministically sampled from y² = x³ − 25x over the recorded display window.
P=(25/4,75/8) is explicitly marked and satisfies the displayed curve equation exactly.
The right triangle has exact side lengths 3/2, 20/3, and 41/6.
The displayed area calculation 1/2·(3/2)·(20/3)=5 is exact.
nonliteral_semantics: The finite plotted real-curve window is not the whole real or rational point set.
Sampling density and line interpolation are rendering choices rather than arithmetic assertions.
No additional visible location is asserted to be a rational point unless explicitly labelled.

notes: Curve samples are generated from the exact polynomial by the recorded deterministic renderer; the distinguished rational point and triangle data are encoded as exact rational constants in the generator.

renderer.version_or_environment: Python 3 standard library; deterministic SVG renderer v1
reproducibility_notes: No randomness or external service is used.
Run the generator from any checkout; output paths and bytes are deterministic under the recorded Python-standard-library contract.

derivatives.role: data-derived vector master; web and print/review candidate

accessibility.alt_text: The exact elliptic curve E5, y squared equals x cubed minus 25x, is plotted with the verified rational point 25 over 4, 75 over 8; beside it is a right triangle with sides 3 over 2, 20 over 3, and 41 over 6 and area 5.
accessibility.long_description: The left panel is a deterministic real plot of E5 over a bounded display window and marks the exact rational point P=(25/4,75/8). The right panel shows a right triangle labelled with the exact rational side lengths 3/2, 20/3, and 41/6 and explicitly computes its area as 5. A boundary box states that finding or plotting a rational point does not prove completeness of E5(Q) and makes no rank or BSD claim.

claim_boundary.strongest_visual_claim: Reproducible exposition of the source-stated exact congruent-number example and one verified rational point.

supersession_reason: The successor replaces an aesthetic cubic substitute with a deterministic rendering of the stated exact curve, point, and area-five triangle.
